attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Before encryption, the threat actors behind Neutrino ransomware exfiltrate sensitive victim data to a cloud storage location under their control as part of their double-extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: Neutrino ransomware encrypts files on local drives and network shares, appending a '.neutrino' extension to render them inaccessible.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The ransomware attempts to delete Volume Shadow Copies using tools like vssadmin.exe to prevent easy recovery from local backups.

malware.name: Neutrino Ransomware
malware.description: A new ransomware family that performs double-extortion by encrypting files (appending the .neutrino extension) and exfiltrating sensitive data, threatening to leak it if the ransom is not paid. It drops a ransom note named 'README-RECOVERY.txt'.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by the ransomware operators to delete Volume Shadow Copies to inhibit system recovery.

infrastructure.name: Neutrino Exfiltration Cloud Storage
infrastructure.description: Cloud storage location controlled by the attackers, used to store exfiltrated victim data as part of the double-extortion scheme.

indicators.name: Neutrino Ransomware Note Creation
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Neutrino Ransomware Note Creation
id: 2b8c1f3a-7d4e-4b9f-8c1d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of the Neutrino ransomware ransom note 'README-RECOVERY.txt'.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-13-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\README-RECOVERY.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of the 'README-RECOVERY.txt' ransom note file dropped by Neutrino ransomware.

indicators.name: Neutrino Encrypted File Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: Neutrino Ransomware Encrypted File
id: 8e9f0a1b-2c3d-4e5f-6a7b-8c9d0e1f2a3b
status: experimental
description: Detects files being renamed with the .neutrino extension, indicating Neutrino ransomware activity.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-13-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: critical
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.neutrino'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects files being created with the '.neutrino' extension, a key indicator of Neutrino ransomware encryption.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-13-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1490
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'VSSADMIN.EXE'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: 1 of selection_img and selection_cli
indicators.description: Detects the execution of 'vssadmin.exe' with commands to delete Volume Shadow Copies, a behavior associated with ransomware like Neutrino to prevent system recovery.

indicators.name: Suspicious Large Data Upload to Cloud Storage
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Large Data Upload to Cloud Storage
id: c4d5e6f7-a8b9-4c0d-1e2f-3a4b5c6d7e8f
status: experimental
description: Detects potentially anomalous large data uploads to common cloud storage providers, which could indicate data exfiltration prior to a ransomware attack.
references:
  - https://www.cyfirma.com/news/weekly-intelligence-report-13-nov-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-13
tags:
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.exfiltration
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host|endswith:
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'dropbox.com'
      - 'drive.google.com'
    sc-bytes|gt: 10000000
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Monitors for large, unexpected data outflows to common cloud storage providers, which could be an indicator of the data exfiltration phase of a double-extortion ransomware attack.

relationships.source_name: Suspicious Large Data Upload to Cloud Storage
